summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K attaching a notice of meeting and proxy statement for a class A meeting and an annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for May 29, 2026. The proposals include increasing voting rights of Class B ordinary shares from 20 to 200 votes per share, a reduction in authorized share capital, and adoption of an amended memorandum and articles. No price, premium, or deal terms are stated as no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or similar special situation is involved. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no special-situation event.
